steps.content: Eirene still won. On top of the disparity in technique and experience, she also strategized more meticulously than you. This chessmaster quickly familiarized herself with the rules you bent, and took advantage of the situation to counterattack.
Now, she gazes at her victory on the chessboard and the pieces who made "unexpected" moves, deep in thought.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Let's go again. I can do this all day.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I won't stop till I beat you. You will point the way for me.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: Ha... you're right. I don't know them well enough to surmise their nature. But your intentions are way too obvious, Chief ${PlayerName}.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: You made an impassioned speech to shake my subconscious and understanding of chess, so as to slowly rewrite the "rules" of this world.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: This is also why you lost every game but still keep on playing... To <color=#fb9259>subvert the chessboard</color>, as you put it.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: I'd love to keep playing with you, but you don't have that much time, do you?
She is truly the master of this lucid dream. Once this kind of psychological tactic has been uncovered, the ensuing challenge will be twice as hard.
But she has a happy smile on her face. You don't know when, but the black "king" has already moved forward one step.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Then have I entertained you enough?

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: Hmm... no.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: If I could, I'd trap you to this chessboard till you struggle to your dying breath, until... I lose interest in you.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: But as you said, you can still provide more entertainment for me. This goes for both you and your chess pieces.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: Oh right, you call them <color=#fb9259>companions</color>...
A ray of light shines into the strange room. Then, a wooden door appears in the center of the room.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: Go, my opponent, my friend. Go resolve your troubles, so you can come back soon to challenge me without distractions.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: Let's set the next battle in your beloved reality.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: When the time comes, you will pay for what you did today, Sinner Eirene.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: Haha, yes. You have a million reasons to take me to the Bureau. But you should know that you will face even more, graver crises in the future.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: When the time comes, will the President of Quinn be of more use to you confined or free?

steps.speaker: Choice
options: I'll think about it. But same goes for you...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I know you have a million ways to clear your name and escape punishment. But think about it...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You yearn for challenges and worthy opponents. Would you rather be stuck in a boring CEO's office, or be in the heart of the coming storm? Which path will better quench your thirst for conquest?

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: ...Haha, well played. I will think about it.
Her gaze returns to the chessboard. The initial illusory figure gradually reappears on the opponent's seat. You now see clearly that it resembles Eirene.

No amount of lucid dreaming can give her an opponent that surpasses her own cognition. Sooner or later, this chessmaster will get bored of always winning and leave this dream to find the next opponent, challenge, and conquest.
But that's not something you should be thinking about right now. You open the door, smell the sweet aroma, and step into the light...
